review_policy: Learner-facing and strategic approval requires explicit independent human review. Deterministic checks may reject stale, invalid, or out-of-scope mutations but can never create an approval.

final_composition.note: Gauntlet 4, final shell cleanup, bounded post-integration workflow-integrity repairs, the Wave C bilingual test-invite gate, v1.2.0 release identity, the N1 novice-scaffold learner composition, FINAL N2 novice-clarity repairs, the final bounded comprehension closure, the exact source-lock closure, and the final low-risk plus-EV clarity cleanup are materialized in the review corpus. The current bounded tester-profile repair isolates local learner state when a verified tester code changes and adds explicit full-progress deletion in Data & Recovery. The bounded post-tester scroll-continuity repair preserves the learner viewport and stable focus anchor when the already-answered Cold Check walkthrough or the lab prediction check is revealed; it changes presentation continuity only. The bounded card-SRS continuity repair clarifies that the two-minute label describes the warm-up session, while the scheduling implementation preserves the existing card intervals and due-time contract. The real-use decision-transfer repair restores concrete, explicitly scoped hand/board representatives where the admitted corpus already supports the mechanism, removes obvious wrong-answer wording tells across the final RU/EN drill corpus, and balances option length so correctness is not signalled by prose length. The final learning-integrity closure removes the remaining material prompt-to-answer leakage, repairs the remaining material distractor-parity clusters, and adds an explicit LCM-02 starting-hand family/traits scaffold with 76s/98s sibling recognition plus contextual A5s transfer. The scaffold is additive to the existing LCM-02 curriculum rather than replacing its heuristics, and it does not add exact chart cells or frequencies. Stable correct-answer IDs, option IDs, misconception IDs, scoring, mastery, scheduler and evidence semantics are preserved. Strategy, drills, exact RU/EN human review and final composition approval remain pending; this deterministic source-lock refresh and machine/agent review are not human approval.
